name: Jorge Luis Cisneros-Zuniga
crime: Charged: NEW ORLEANS, LA – In a recently unsealed indictment, JORGE LUIS CISNEROS-ZUNIGA (“CISNEROS-ZUNIGA”), 52, a native of Mexico, was indicted on November 13, 2026, for reentry of a removed alien, in violation of Title 8, United States Code, Section 1326(a) and (b)(1), announced U.S. Attorney David I. Courcelle. According to the indictment, on or about September 21, 2026, in the Eastern District of Louisiana, CISNEROS-ZUNIGA, an alien, was found in the United States after having been deported and removed therefrom on or about August 22, 2007, without the approval of the Attorney General of the United States or his designated successor, the Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security, having expressly consented to the defendant’s reapplication for admission into the United States, in violation of Title 8, United States Code, Section 1326(a).
